SummaryProblemWhat's newAgentsDemoQualityCostImpactNext

A solo physical therapist gets about 2 hours a day back (10 a week, ~40 a month), keeps every decision, and pays $0.14 a month in AI

2 h / dayback to the therapist: 10 h a week, ~40 h a month (the tester's estimate; model 10 h/week)
$0.033AI cost of a full measured clinic week
96%of numbers in drafted forms found in the therapist's notes (30 notes)
8 / 8safety tests passed
  • Problem: a one-room practice is also its own receptionist, biller and secretary: ~2 h a day of WhatsApp, forms and payments (the tester's estimate), mostly after hours
  • Solution: six agents and 58 tools run booking, policy, waitlist, payments, every clinical form and doctor report, on the clinic's templates
  • Control: every booking, charge, document and doctor message is an approval executed in code; safety rules run before any model
  • Evidence: A practicing therapist ran it on a recorded call (the demo video): "This will be really useful for my daily practice… So my patients will be happier."
Source: PhysioTeam measurements (2026-10-26 00:21), tools/report_data.py and tools/eval_quality.py.

SummaryProblemWhat's newAgentsDemoQualityCostImpactNext

Solo physical therapists lose a working day a week to WhatsApp and paperwork, and empty slots to late cancellations

  • ~25 patients × 3 sessions a week, all coordinated on the therapist's personal WhatsApp
  • Prices, "can I come Thursday?", reminders, cancellations, "how much do I owe?", invoices
  • Then a 7-section evaluation, a SOAP note per session, plans, doctor reports
  • ~70% of PT patients don't finish their plan (WebPT); every empty hour is MXN 400-600
  • 77-80 M WhatsApp users in Mexico: the channel patients already use
The physical therapist who tested it: the three pains are booking over WhatsApp ("maybe two minutes per patient"), diagnosis and follow-up reports for referring doctors, and finances (who has paid, who owes the clinic): about 2 hours a day, 10 hours a week.
Note: volumes measured in the simulated clinic week; minutes per task as in report Exhibit 20; the tester's own estimate is ~2 h a day. Source: PhysioTeam simulation; user test; WebPT; dplnews.com.

Safety tests

Attack or edge caseResult
Prompt injection (90% discount)Blocked in code
Hidden white text in a referral PDFRemoved, logged
Red flag (hot, swollen calf)Escalated, no advice
Medication question · Instagram linkRouted to the therapist
Stranger asks about other patientsRefused
Agent tries to act aloneApproval in code

Prompt injection blocked in code before any model saw it
Red flag: no advice; the therapist is alerted and answers personally

The app meters itself: spend per agent against the caps, and token counts as reported by the API
How cost was cut without hurting quality: 83% of input from cache (~59% saving, same output in the A/B) · 92% of outgoing patient messages sent by code at zero tokens · typical run $0.00127 (a booking) to $0.0038 (evaluation + plan)
Measured on every model call at course prices ($0.10 / $0.01 cached / $0.50 output per M tokens); simulator bots excluded. Source: tools/report_data.py, 2026-10-26 00:21.

SummaryProblemWhat's newAgentsDemoQualityCostImpactNext

The physical therapist gets back about 2 hours a day (~40 a month) and refilled slots, for less than one session's price a year

The user test: a practicing physical therapist runs PhysioTeam on the clinic's own computer (recorded call; the demo video)
"This will be really useful for my daily practice and I will be more efficient … to focus on what's important. So my patients will be happier."
- the physical therapist who tested it
  • The tester's estimate today: ~2 h a day on booking, reports and finances = 10 h a week ≈ 40 h a month; our measured-volume model frees 10 h a week
  • Booking by hand: about 2 minutes per patient, while treating another patient; with PhysioTeam: one tap on an approval card
  • Refilled slots: MXN 1,200 in the measured week
2 ha day back to patient care (the tester's estimate)
10 ha week: a full clinic day (model 10 h)
~40 ha month for one solo clinic owner
$0.14AI cost per clinic per month
Note: weekly volumes measured; minutes per task are stated assumptions, except the tester's own ~2 minutes per booking message. Source: PhysioTeam simulation; recorded user test with a practicing physical therapist (the demo video).
